name: Refugees International
summary: A Washington-based advocacy organisation founded in 1979 that researches displacement crises and presses the US government, the UN and host governments for aid, access and protection for refugees and displaced people (Sudan and Chad, Gaza, the DRC, Ukraine, Latin America and the US asylum system). It takes no government or UN funding.
